sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO biological specimen records and source donor IDs; all repeated patient IDs stay linked.

source_metadata.access: Public GEO processed count matrices; controlled raw sequence access not required

title: patient 11, Day 0, Short Responder
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from 10 patients at day 0 and 14 (D0 and D14) with castrate levels of testosterone (<50 mg/dL) underwent continued ADT and stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) : 5 with poor response, and 5 with good response.
Library was peformed according to the manufacter's instructions (single cell 3' v2 protocol, 10xGenomics).
data_processing: Image data were processed using the Illumina Standard Pipeline.

Cellranger (v7.0.1) was used for demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting, cell clustering, and aggregation analyses with TCR-seq. The reference database (refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A) was downloaded from 10X Genomics.
Seurat package 4.2.0 was used for downstream analyses.
Assembly: GRCh38/hg38.
Supplementary files format and content: HDF5 (Hierarchical Data Format).
